{{Quote|I was born for this moment. We go!|Treek|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Treek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who left her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] by commandeering a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] whose crash-landing she had witnessed.

==Biography==
Treek was from the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to her kind, the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]. Her [[Chief/Legends|chief]] had told Treek to stay in their village, where she would cook and raise children like the other Ewok women, but instead she became an adventurer journeying across her world.

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Treek_holonet_companions.jpg|thumb|250px|Treek]]
The [[Gender/Legends|female]] Ewok found her companion to be a good leader, and her travels to exciting planets and destruction of their enemies to be a good life. Treek considered herself highly attractive by her kind's standards, claiming that the men would endlessly try to gain her favor although she wanted none of it.

==Behind the scenes==
Treek is listed as the newest player's companion in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as of Game Update 2.3 and can be acquired by players of both factions. If Treek is a Republic player's companion, she will tell the player, during conversations, about her soft and more benevolent story, whereas if she is an Imperial player's companion, she will speak of a more brutal and dark past.

===Empire===
On her travels across Endor, she saw wonders such as the [[Blurrg's Isle]], the [[Desert of Salma/Legends|Desert of Salma]] and [[Lake Greetac]], and she also claimed to hunt mighty beasts. In the [[Sagreb Swamps]], Treek fought and defeated single-handedly a whole tribe of [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] who had accused her of trespassing, later claiming their ears for her necklace.

===Alliance===
If the player unlocked Treek as a companion prior to starting the expansion, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'', she will appear as a cameo during '''Chapter IX: The Alliance''', where she will voice her lack of interest in the festivities and leave to go hunting, and [[Tora]] will ask what she is saying. If the player also acquired [[HK-51]] as a companion prior to the expansion, he will translate for her. If the player did not acquire HK-51, [[Ralo]] will translate for her instead.<ref name="Chapter 9">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=9}}</ref>
